description: Search Lightning FM's Nostr music catalog, look up artists, and check what's live now.
name: fm.lightning/lightning-fm-mcp

environmentVariables.description: Comma-separated relay URLs to query. Only add a relay here if it gates writes the way relay.lightning.fm does (allowlisted artists only) — an unrestricted public relay hands back every other app's kind-31337 events too, not just Lightning FM's.
environmentVariables.name: LFM_NOSTR_RELAYS

environmentVariables.description: Blossom server audio/image hashes resolve against.
environmentVariables.name: LFM_BLOSSOM_URL

environmentVariables.description: How long a fetched catalog/profile/now-playing snapshot is reused, in milliseconds, before the next tool call re-queries the relays.
environmentVariables.name: LFM_CACHE_TTL_MS
